phase.title: Stable Character Animation and Pre-Match Preparation

milestones.title: Stable jump and stop presentation
milestones.evidence: Reproduced one-shot restarts and affine face blend distortion. Generated component tracks and symmetric held air poses; CHARACTER_ANIMATION_OK67 including interrupted shove/get-up and repeat setup.

milestones.title: Explicit startup mode/map/outfit preparation
milestones.evidence: STARTUP_MENU_OK17: no timer/director before play, actual starter equip, map/preset selection, explicit solo start and results-to-lobby. Final720p/1080p startup/equipped/map-selection captures inspected, labels/placeholder fit.

scope.request: Owner reports jumping arm wobble, face movement on stopping, unavailable equipment and immediate solo instead of a mode/outfit/map menu.
scope.constraints: Reuse existing lobby/collection/preset contracts, preserve dedicated authority and CLI network/demo startup. No new model geometry, maps, hazards or infrastructure.
scope.delivery: Source commit/push per repository policy. Prior Phase13 deploy/release authorization was fulfilled; no new deployment inferred.

user_acceptance_waiver.decision: Existing manual-check prerequisites waived for continuation; preserve actual outcomes and unresolved technical causes. No native/human/network acceptance claimed. Full original waiver preserved in previous phase archive.

validation.result: CHARACTER_ANIMATION_OK checks=67. Takeoff held0.6s, falling cycle, walk/run-to-idle face stability, cue interruption and idempotent setup.

STARTUP_MENU_OK checks=17; rendered same scenario with xvfb and Dummy audio. Initial immediate shutdown retained WAV playback resources; fixture now drains audio before freeing, rendered log clean apart from software V-Sync warning.

validation.command: GODOT_BIN=$(command -v godot) tests/run_ui_regression.sh and serial continuation
validation.result: Initial stop: map-detail rematch assertions assumed automatic solo startup. Subsequent continuation caught obsolete preparation-close expectation and audio test assuming no prior focus cue/voice index0. Fixtures now explicitly start active rounds; preparation must remain open, audio assertions measure relative effects and actual reused voice. No production authority/audio weakened. Later suites passing; final staged-tree regression pending.

validation.command: xvfb-run Godot tests/test_startup_menu.gd --capture-menu with720p/1080p and Dummy audio
validation.result: STARTUP_MENU_OK17 at both widths. All six final startup/equipped/map-mode captures inspected; no clipping or HUD overlap. Shortened room-ID placeholder after initial1080p inspection caught truncation. .amp/in/artifacts/character-menu/; software V-Sync warning only.

validation.command: xvfb-run Godot scratch manual animation sampler; ffmpeg frame sequence
validation.result: CHARACTER_RENDER_OK138 frames sampled30Hz, final animation.mp4 inspected: stable held takeoff/falling, run-to-idle face remains attached. Oblique projection accounts for screen arm length difference; equal rotations asserted. Three-frame shove interruption not legible at video sampling; its restoration is covered by focused numerical regression, not claimed visually proven.

POINTER_OS_INPUT_OK for all three roles, actual X11 clicks/motion/keys: startup Play Solo, camera, pause/settings/resume/focus and server-loss return to preparation then explicit solo Start. No audible-audio claim.

validation.command: Repeat generator9 character-only seed297; archive/links/manifest validation
validation.result: CHARACTER_GENERATION_DETERMINISTIC_OK byte-identical. PHASE13_ARCHIVE_PAYLOAD_OK all27 original keys preserved except historical source/workflow flags; tracking Markdown targets, JSON and character SHA256 match.

limits: Native Windows/GPU/audio and human animation feel unverified.
Earlier intermittent packet-loss timeout remains deferred; this task does not investigate it.
next_action: Finish remaining serial suites, then run the exact staged-tree commit gate and push verified source without deploying.
